chunks: "Whoever holds back his saliva out of reverence for Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, during his salat (prayer), Allah, Exalted is He, will grant him health until death."
ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say about showing reverence in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches reverence and refined etiquette in salat (prayer), showing that even small bodily acts can reflect one's veneration of Allah. It links inward respect during worship with a worldly blessing of enduring health until death.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.854 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) said:
"Whoever holds back their saliva out of reverence for Allah (swt), the Mighty and Majestic, during prayer, Allah (swt) will grant them health until their death."
